hero.title: Moving Jordan forward, one shipment at a time.
hero.subtitle: Cross-border trucking between Jordan and Saudi Arabia, both directions — bulk commodities, project cargo and general freight on an owned fleet with trained drivers.

highlights.title: A carrier that treats your delivery date as the deliverable.

reach.title: Jordan ⇄ Saudi Arabia, both ways
reach.body: Regular running between Amman, Aqaba and the Saudi industrial centres — and back loaded, not empty, which is what keeps our rates competitive.

fleet.title: Owned fleet, in-house drivers
fleet.body: Flatbeds, curtain-siders, tippers, tankers and lowbeds we own and maintain ourselves, driven by people on our payroll rather than spot-market subcontractors.

cargo.title: Built for difficult loads
cargo.body: Bulk carbonates and potash, chemicals, steel, cement, packaging and palletised FMCG — each on the trailer type it actually needs.

control.title: One coordinator per shipment
control.body: A named person who knows your load, tracks it across the border and calls you before you have to call us.

services.title: Freight services
services.subtitle: Four ways we move goods, all on the same fleet and the same coordination desk.

crossBorder.title: Cross-border freight
crossBorder.short: Jordan to Saudi Arabia and back, on schedule.
crossBorder.body: Scheduled and on-demand trucking between Jordan and Saudi Arabia with the border formalities handled as part of the job, not as your problem.

bulk.title: Bulk commodities
bulk.body: Tipper and bulk trailers for mineral and chemical loads, with the loading and discharge coordination that bulk shippers need at both ends.

projectCargo.title: Project & heavy cargo
projectCargo.short: Lowbeds for plant, machinery and oversize loads.
projectCargo.body: Lowbed and extendable trailers for machinery, plant and out-of-gauge pieces, including route planning and the permits an oversize move requires.

general.title: General & palletised freight
general.short: Curtain-siders for FMCG, packaging and steel.
general.body: Curtain-sided and flatbed capacity for palletised goods, packaging, steel and finished products moving between plants, ports and distribution centres.

clients.title: The shippers who keep our trucks moving.

cta.title: Have a load to move?
cta.subtitle: Tell us the origin, the destination and what is on the pallet. We will come back with a rate and a date within one business day.

fleet.title: The right trailer for the load, not the one that happened to be free.
fleet.subtitle: We own and maintain our own equipment, so what turns up is what was booked.
fleet.intro: A mixed fleet matters more than a big one. Sending bagged cement on a curtain-sider, or a transformer on a standard flatbed, costs more in delays and damage than the rate ever saves. These are the trailer types we run and what each one is for.

flatbed.title: Flatbeds
flatbed.body: The workhorse for steel, pipe, machinery and anything crated. Loaded and secured from either side or from above, which makes them the fastest to turn around at a busy yard.

curtainSider.title: Curtain-siders
curtainSider.body: Weather protection with flatbed access. Used for palletised FMCG, packaging, paper and finished goods that need to stay dry but still load from the side.

tippers.title: Tippers & bulk trailers
tippers.body: For carbonates, potash, aggregates and other loose mineral loads, discharging by tipping rather than needing plant at the receiving end.

lowbeds.title: Lowbeds & extendables
lowbeds.body: For plant, machinery and out-of-gauge pieces that exceed normal height or length limits. Route surveys and permits are arranged as part of the move.

tankers.title: Tankers
tankers.body: For bulk liquid and chemical loads, cleaned and certified between products so there is no carry-over between consignments.

maintenance.title: In-house maintenance
maintenance.body: Our own workshop and mechanics. A trailer that fails on the Saudi side is a week's delay, so preventive servicing is scheduled rather than reactive.

seo.title: Truck & Trailer Fleet
seo.description: Flatbeds, curtain-siders, tippers, lowbeds and tankers owned and maintained in-house by Abu Sonbul Arab Transporters for cross-border freight between Jordan and Saudi Arabia.

routes.title: Regular lanes, not one-off adventures.
routes.subtitle: Running the same corridors week in, week out is what makes schedules predictable and return legs loaded.
routes.intro: Rates and transit times get better the more often a carrier runs a lane. These are the corridors we work continuously, in both directions — which is why we can quote a return leg rather than charging you for an empty run home.

central.title: Jordan ⇄ Riyadh and central Saudi Arabia
central.body: Our busiest corridor, running through the Al-Omari crossing. Regular departures in both directions serving industrial and FMCG clients on each side.

western.title: Jordan ⇄ Jeddah and the western region
western.body: The long haul down the western side of the Kingdom, typically for building materials, packaging and project consignments.

eastern.title: Jordan ⇄ Dammam, Jubail and the Eastern Province
eastern.body: Serving the industrial and petrochemical belt, where the return leg is frequently bulk chemical or mineral product coming north.

domestic.title: Inside Jordan and Aqaba port
domestic.body: Port collections and deliveries at Aqaba, movements between plants and distribution centres, and runs out to project sites in the east and south.

seo.title: Freight Routes Jordan to Saudi Arabia
seo.description: Regular loaded lanes between Jordan and Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam via the Al-Omari crossing, plus Aqaba port and domestic Jordanian movements.

cargo.title: Cargo we know how to handle.
cargo.subtitle: Every category below is something we move regularly — not something we would be learning on your load.
cargo.intro: Freight goes wrong in the details: how a load is secured, what it may not travel next to, what paperwork it needs at a border. These are the commodity groups we handle week to week, and the reasons each one needs treating differently.

minerals.title: Carbonates, potash and minerals
minerals.body: Bulk and bagged mineral product moving in both directions between Jordanian and Saudi processors. Weight-critical loads where axle compliance matters as much as the rate.

chemicals.title: Chemicals and industrial liquids
chemicals.body: Handled with the documentation, segregation and trailer cleaning that chemical consignments require, in dedicated equipment.

building.title: Steel, cement and building materials
building.body: Heavy, dense and unforgiving of poor securing. Loaded to spread weight correctly and strapped for a two-day run rather than a two-hour one.

fmcg.title: FMCG, food and packaging
fmcg.body: Palletised consumer goods and packaging materials for regional manufacturers and distributors, where the delivery window is usually the whole point.

project.title: Project and out-of-gauge cargo
project.body: Plant, machinery and pieces that will not fit a standard trailer, moved with route planning, permits and escorts where the load requires them.

seo.title: Cargo Types We Haul
seo.description: Carbonates and potash, chemicals, steel and cement, palletised FMCG and out-of-gauge project cargo moved between Jordan and Saudi Arabia.

home.title: Cross-Border Trucking Jordan & Saudi Arabia
home.description: Abu Sonbul Arab Transporters moves bulk, project and general cargo between Jordan and Saudi Arabia on an owned fleet with in-house drivers. Established in Jordan since 2008.
